# CPLT Online — the CPLT private AI platform, shown working

> cplt.online is the demonstration site for CPLT (https://cplt.tech), an
> association founded by Stéphane Lepain that helps regulated EU teams
> understand private, self-hosted AI on their own servers — and takes on
> paid fixed-scope builds, designed and handed over for the customer to
> run. This site shows the platform working; it carries no pricing, no
> engagement structure and no contact route of its own. For what CPLT is,
> what it builds, and how to get in touch, use https://cplt.tech and
> https://cplt.tech/llms.txt. Enquiries go to https://cplt.tech/contact.

What is shown here:
- A supplier assurance workflow, representative of one that has run in
  production for two years (client, framework and control set are
  confidential): documents go in as they arrive; every control is walked every
  time; a rival model from a different company challenges the result before it
  sees the assessment; a third company's model validates the document;
  fifteen mechanical checks run; a person signs off; every finding cites its
  page.
- Measured results from that stack: on a fifty-case blind benchmark the open
  model matched the frontier model 50/50 with zero false passes at roughly a
  third of the running cost, and was still not promoted to lead assessor
  because an earlier four-case run had hidden seven false passes; lexical
  retrieval scored 95.8 against 11.7 for embedding retrieval on the
  identifier lookups compliance work depends on.
- Everyday chat that sizes each question and picks the model automatically,
  with the data boundary set by the customer, not the router.
- Architecture: the customer chooses where it runs (own hardware, private
  cloud tenancy, or shared), CPLT builds it, the customer operates it, using
  the customer's own provider API keys. The data boundary is a consequence of
  four choices, not a fixed table.
- Security: an eight-rule ownership charter for the AI agents, and recovery
  objectives (service restart under 1 minute, database restore under 30
  minutes, bare-metal rebuild under 2 hours, 24-hour data-loss window, zero
  configuration loss) drilled quarterly.
- An interactive demo of a document pipeline failing silently on a diagram
  page, and the routed pipeline catching it. The document is fictional; the
  failure mode is real.

Pages:
- [Overview](https://cplt.online/)
- [See it fail](https://cplt.online/demo): the interactive failure demo
- [How it works](https://cplt.online/how-it-works): the worked example, the
  review chain, the benchmarks, automatic model selection
- [Architecture](https://cplt.online/deployment): where it runs and what
  that decides
- [Security](https://cplt.online/security): agent charter and recovery
  objectives

Interface content shown on this site is fictional and representative. The
measurements are real and come from CPLT's own production stack. Outputs of
the platform are probabilistic; the independent checks and the human gate
exist because no model is reliable on its own.
